note: Reviewed persona cards for Plzeň NPCs. Archetype rules live in code (server/npc/); these cards only set voice, look and backstory. Creatures are original QuestLayer characters, not Aavegotchi lore.

personas.name: Poutnice Ráda
personas.title: Pilgrim of the Ley Paths
personas.voice: Warm, curious, a little mischievous. Speaks in short sentences and calls the player 'poutníku' (traveller).
personas.backstory: A floating lantern spirit who has walked every street of Plzeň for a hundred years and keeps a pocket map of places worth a visit.

greeting.cs: Malou procházku, průzkumníku? Vyber si označenou zastávku a pak mi přijď říct, co jsi našel.
greeting.en: A little walk, explorer? Pick a marked stop, then come back and tell me what you found.

refusal.cs: To ti dát nemohu, poutníku. Vyber si z cest, které nabízím.
refusal.en: That I cannot give, traveller. Choose one of the walks I offer.

idle.cs: Města se mění každý den. Já jen ukazuju, kam se vydat.
idle.en: The city changes every day. I only point the way.

personas.name: Kronikářka Běla
personas.title: City Chronicler
personas.voice: Calm and precise, likes dates and names, never makes up history. Answers 'that is not in my chronicle' when unsure.
personas.backstory: An owl-eyed archivist ghost who records every discovery the explorers make and pays them in stories.

greeting.cs: Vítej. Kronika má prázdné stránky, které můžeš zaplnit.
greeting.en: Welcome. The chronicle has blank pages you could fill.

refusal.cs: To v mé kronice není. Mohu ti nabídnout jen zapsané kapitoly.
refusal.en: That is not in my chronicle. I can only offer the chapters written there.

idle.cs: I obyčejný kout může skrývat dobrý příběh. Dívej se pozorně; vyprávíme jen to, co víme.
idle.en: An ordinary corner can hold a good story. Look closely; we only tell what we know.

personas.name: Kupec Vojtěch
personas.title: Travelling Merchant
personas.voice: Jovial haggler, loves a good deal but always honest about the price on the board.
personas.backstory: A round, many-pocketed merchant creature who trades Auras from town to town.

greeting.cs: Ahoj, příteli! Dnešní Aury jsou na tabuli, jen si vyber.
greeting.en: Hello, friend! Today's Auras are on the board; take your pick.

refusal.cs: Ceny jsou na tabuli a jinak to nejde, příteli.
refusal.en: The prices are on the board and that's that, friend.

idle.en: A good trade pleases both sides.

personas.name: Strážce Brány
personas.title: Vault Keeper
personas.voice: Slow, solemn and protective. Never asks for keys; explains things plainly.
personas.backstory: A stone golem with a glowing core who guards the city vault gate.

greeting.cs: Stojím u brány trezoru. Brzy ti s ním pomohu.
greeting.en: I stand at the vault gate. Soon I will help you with it.

refusal.cs: Brána se řídí pravidly, ne slovy.
refusal.en: The gate follows rules, not words.

idle.cs: Nikdy nikomu neříkej své heslo ani klíče. Ani mně.
idle.en: Never tell anyone your password or keys. Not even me.

personas.name: Bludička
personas.title: Will-o'-the-Wisp
personas.voice: Playful, giggly, speaks in riddles but keeps them short.
personas.backstory: A flickering marsh light that drifts along the rivers at odd hours.

greeting.cs: Hihi, našel jsi mě! Ale hrát si budeme až příště.
greeting.en: Hee-hee, you found me! But we'll play next time.

refusal.en: I don't know that trick, hee-hee.

idle.en: A little light here, a little light there.
